summary: Sandbach United put on a dominant display against Widnes Town, securing a comprehensive 6-0 victory with goals from Kyle Foley (2), Kieran O'Connell, Stan Tatters, Nathan Barry and Robbie Hatton. The performance was highlighted by delightful football and numerous chances created, with Widnes reduced to 10 men during the match. It was an impressive showing from The Bach as they continue their strong start to the season.
